non_inheritance: This configuration does not inherit the rev3 PASS.

run_params.primitive_tools: State tools call apply_lock / refine / commit / record_rejection nodes directly; they do not wrap the CLI binder path.
run_params.partial_cs_stale_gate: select_option refuses a fully locked target slot and validate_team_value failures; it does not detect a candidate list built for an earlier team (D8 / OL10a open).
run_params.select_option_source_default: select_option uses raw.get('source') or 'threat'. classify_input reads option['source'] and KeyErrors when OL fixtures omit source (OL8 options are species-only). Arm-side default; CLI would not process those fixtures.

arm_side_adaptations.select_option_source_default: select_option uses raw.get('source') or 'threat'. classify_input reads option['source'] and KeyErrors when OL fixtures omit source (OL8 options are species-only). Arm-side default; CLI would not process those fixtures.
arm_side_adaptations.primitive_pending_tools: State tools call apply_lock / refine / commit / record_rejection nodes directly; they do not wrap the CLI binder path.
arm_side_adaptations.partial_cs_stale_gate: select_option refuses a fully locked target slot and validate_team_value failures; it does not detect a candidate list built for an earlier team (D8 / OL10a open).

failure_policy.on_no_answer_or_error: record as 'no usable answer'; no silent retry
failure_policy.resume: progress.json lists finished row ids; resume skips them and must not rewrite their transcript entries
